description: Configure Webmin's IP Access Control to restrict access to the server. Navigate to the 'Webmin Configuration' module (under the Webmin tab), then select 'IP Access Control'. Configure the system to 'Only allow from listed addresses' and add EXACTLY these two IP addresses: '127.0.0.1' (Localhost) and '10.8.0.42' (Admin VPN). Save the configuration. WARNING: You must include 127.0.0.1 or you will lock yourself out of the interface.
